method.goal: group scripts that do nearly the same job
method.score_formula: 0.52*(0.55*cos_all + 0.30*containment + 0.15*cos_api) + 0.48*(0.50*cos_purpose + 0.25*cos_api + 0.25*name_sim); plus a filename-variant boost (name_sim >= 0.72) and a near-literal-copy boost (containment >= 0.85)
method.idf: log((N+1)/(df+1)) + 0.15; features with df > 300 or df > 45% of N are dropped
method.clustering: frontier expansion from the densest script (a group may grow through any member) with a cohesion test and one conservative refinement pass

score_components.cos_api: cosine over imports, called APIs and CLI flags
score_components.cos_purpose: cosine over imports, calls, CLI flags, defined names, doc/comment words and filename words (no code shingles)
score_components.name_sim: similarity of normalised, corpus-segmented filename stems

caveats: Static analysis only: no script was executed.
Files that fail to parse on Python 3.11 use lexical features only.
Similarity measures implementation/purpose overlap, not proven equivalence.
